gates.audit: appendCrudAudit with factoring.batch.submitted event tagged FACT-PAR-1

deferred: financed factoring_status — not in migration 0061 CHECK constraint; faro-csv-import already sets 'advanced' which covers the funded semantic. Adding 'financed' requires ALTER TABLE DROP+ADD CHECK = new migration = HOLD.
submission_window (AM/PM batch window) — requires ALTER TABLE factoring.batch ADD COLUMN = new migration = no hold, owner law 2026-08-03,.
